body.statement: The language of unsatisfiable Boolean formulas in \(3\)-CNF is \(\mathsf{coNP}\)-complete under polynomial many-one reductions.

source.locator: Section 3, paragraph after Definition 3 on page 3, and the 3-SAT hardness use in the proof of Lemma 1 on page 8

upstream.citation: Craig A. Tovey. A simplified NP-complete satisfiability problem. Discrete Applied Mathematics 8(1):85--89, 1984. DOI: 10.1016/0166-218X(84)90081-7.

attestation.note: The satisfiability premise was checked in the open-access published PDF; the primary restricted 3-SAT result and the complementation step are recorded explicitly.
